create_generate_sprites: create a callable sprite generator that samples sprites from a factor distribution with a specified count
build_chain_generators: build a combined sprite generator that concatenates multiple sprite generator outputs into one sequence
sample_sprite_generator: sample one sprite generator from a set of generators with optional weighted probabilities
shuffle_sprite_order: shuffle the order of sprites from a generator to randomize z-layer occlusion
test_sprite_generators: test the sprite_generators module functions for generating, chaining, sampling, and shuffling sprite lists
